graphicsGuidance.title: Extended Distance Scaling
graphicsGuidance.detail: Heavily CPU-bound; lower it first if the CPU is at its limit.

graphicsGuidance.title: MSAA
graphicsGuidance.detail: Very expensive in the legacy edition; prefer FXAA or the Enhanced edition's upscalers.
